name: @theoremjs/studio
description: Repo-private studio for theorem hosts: the profile draft, its tree and compiler, source export, the travel concierge demo, and the studio screen. Never published. Opt-in: nothing here is installed with the kernel or the React package; `npm install` in this folder is what lets the screen run on its own.

scripts.test: node installed.mjs && npm run theme:check && deno test --config ../deno.json --no-check --allow-read --allow-env --allow-sys tests
